messages:
Maria P.: Quick FYI — opening a PR to add an "example matrix" for the Optimize toolkit that shows concrete tradeoffs for batching, caching, and quant profiles across three workload archetypes (chat-short, summarization-long, batched-embeds). PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/12345

Darren: nice. can you include the default knobs you want us to benchmark? suggest batch sizes [1, 8, 64], cache modes [off, prefix, kv], quant [fp16, int8, 4bit]. i'll run the perf harness once you push samples.

Maria P.: yep — i'll include a small table and runnable SDK snippets for each cell. plan: one python snippet for sync generation, one async streaming for chat, and one batched embeddings example.

Yang L.: for the snippets, use the new request options shape: `client.generate(model=\"open-redwood-1\", input=..., options={\"batch_size\": N, \"cache_mode\": \"prefix\" , \"quant_profile\": \"int8\"})` — that maps to the runtime flags we test. sample:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
resp = client.generate(model="open-redwood-1", input="Summarize this...", options={"batch_size": 8, "cache_mode": "prefix", "quant_profile": "fp16"})
print(resp.text)
```

Leo K.: also add a short note about memory vs latency with batch=64 for long sequences — we saw OOM when kv cache stayed enabled on 24GB instances. maybe mark that cell as "high mem risk" and point to Dedicated profiling docs.

Sophie R.: can we surface the recommended starting point for each archetype? eg chat-short -> batch 1, cache prefix, fp16; summarization-long -> batch 8, cache kv, int8; embeds-batched -> batch 64, cache off, int8. that helps people pick quickly.

Maria P.: good idea. i'll add a one-line recommendation per row and a TL;DR callout. also adding runnable ci smoke tests in the PR that run 3 small scenarios. tagging @Darren for perf numbers on int8 vs fp16.

Darren: will run perf harness tonight and drop numbers as a followup comment in the PR. :eyes:

DocsBot: CI run for PR #12345 started — running doc-snippets smoke suite.

DocsBot: CI results: 3 tests failed — embeds-batch (timeout), gen-chat-large (OOM on 24GB), sample-snippet-lint (pyflakes). Logs: https://ci.redwood/inference/12345/logs

Maria P.: thanks — i'll lower embed batch to 32 for the snippet, wrap large-gen snippet with a note about using Dedicated or lower batch, and fix lint. pushing update now.

Maria P.: pushed patch (force-push) at 2381234602 — updated batch sizes and added the TL;DR. PR now includes link to the benchmark script and raw CSV.

Darren: ran benchmarks on the updated matrix. numbers look sane, added microsecond latency and token-cost columns in the PR comments. approved for content.

Yang L.: code snippet nit: use `with client.streaming(...)` pattern for chat to show partial responses. small change recommended, i'll add a commit.

Sophie R.: editorial note — please avoid the word "best" in recommendations; use "recommended starting point" to reflect workload variance.

Maria P.: updated wording and accepted Yang's streaming commit. thanks all.

DocsBot: PR #12345 merged into main at 2381234605 — docs site rebuild scheduled. :tada:

Darren: nice. can we follow up in a week to check telemetry for people who hit the examples? might surface more real-world tweaks.

Maria P.: agreed — i'll open a follow-up issue to collect telemetry and any missing cells.

Sophie R.: thanks for coordinating everyone — this matrix is going to be super helpful for customers and SDK users. :heart:
